svg.title: Meadow Flooring Atelier hardwood installation portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional flooring portfolio concept for Meadow Flooring Atelier, showing a completed light-oak hardwood floor with natural grain. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
